findings.desc: process-group-safety: packages/main/src/core/managed-host-run.ts:1374 sends SIGKILL to -child.pid after checking only child.pid > 1. This negative-PGID signal has no isolated-group or start-fingerprint revalidation, so a descriptor-delivery failure after PID/PGID reuse can signal an unrelated process group. Reuse the verified isolated-group/fingerprint guard or kill only the direct child and record replacementSafe=false.
